title: Filming: Imagine by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono continued filming material for their feature film Imagine on 18 July 1971.

The filming took place at Tittenhurst Park, their home in Ascot, England. They were repeatedly filmed walking to the front door of their house, with a smoke machine creating the illusion of mist. The cameras also lingered on the sign above the door which read “THIS IS NOT HERE”. The sequence later formed the beginning of the video for the song ‘Imagine’.

At this point the film had the working title Your Show.
